info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Order Retrieval API
info.description: The Payment Order Retrieval API enables users to access and review detailed information about payment orders in the banking system. This endpoint allows financial institutions and developers to retrieve specific payment order data for analysis and reporting purposes. Typical use cases include auditing payment transactions, monitoring payment statuses, and integrating payment order details into financial applications. By leveraging this API, clients can enhance their financial operations and ensure better transaction management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific payment order, providing key information such as the status and monetary amounts involved.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payment order information. It should include the necessary parameters for identifying the payment order.

GetPaymentOrderRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to payment orders.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer authentication, where a JSON Web Token (JWT) is provided as a bearer token in the HTTP Authorization header. It is a standard method for transmitting claims between parties and is commonly used in RESTful APIs.
